title: My routine
grammar: Simple Present (I / you / we / they) + horas
today: Hoje você vai aprender a contar a sua rotina: o que você faz todo dia, o que você não faz e a que horas. E ainda vai perguntar a rotina dos outros com Do you…?
canDo: Contar o que você faz todo dia: I wake up at 7:30
Negar com don't e perguntar com Do you…?
Perguntar e falar as horas: What time do you…? At 5 o'clock.

video.context: A Sian, da BBC, conta o que ela faz num dia normal, desde a hora que acorda até a hora de dormir. No fim, o Buli tem uma pergunta pra você.
video.predict: Antes de ouvir: o que você acha que a Sian faz depois do trabalho? Ela mora perto do mar…

options: Sian's routine: what she does every day

questions.q: After work, Sian: "I swim in the…"
Buli: "How about you? What do you do…"

lines.text: Hi! I'm Tony, from 101.
**So**, every day I wake up at 7:30. But this week? Music at 5 AM!
On Tuesday, I go to apartment 12.
Jenny, do you wake up at 5?
No, I don't. I wake up at 4:45. **You know**, I go jogging at 5. With music!
Music?! I don't go jogging. I go to sleep at 12!
Oh no! What time do you wake up?
OK, I'm gonna go jogging at 7:30. How about you?
**Well**… OK. No music!

options: Jenny is gonna go jogging at 7:30
Tony is gonna go to sleep at 5
Jenny is gonna go to apartment 101

chunks.tip: Wake up é abrir o olho, acordar. Go to sleep é ir dormir. Pra dizer a hora: at + hora (at 7:30).
examples: Every day I wake up at 7:30.

alt: I go to sleep at eleven
I wake up at five thirty

chunks.tip: Every day (separado!) = todo dia. Pode ir no começo ou no fim da frase. E correr de exercício é go jogging.
examples: Every day I wake up at 7:30.

practice.en: Every day I wake up at 7
alt: Every day, I wake up at 7
I wake up at 7 every day
Every day I wake up at seven
I wake up at seven every day

chunks.tip: Pra negar a rotina: don't + verbo. I don't go = eu não vou. Nada de "I no go"! Com I, you, we, they o verbo não muda.

alt: I do not wake up at 5
I don't wake up at five
I do not wake up at five
They go to sleep at ten

chunks.chunk: Do you…? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
chunks.tip: Pergunta de rotina começa com Do: Do you wake up at 5? A resposta curta usa do de novo: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
examples: Jenny, do you wake up at 5?
No, I don't. I wake up at 4:45.
Do you go jogging? Yes, I do.

alt: Do you wake up at six?

practice.en: Do you go to sleep at 12? No, we don't
alt: Do you go to sleep at 12? No, we do not
Do you go to sleep at twelve? No, we don't

chunks.chunk: What time do you…? — At 7:30. / How about you?
chunks.pt: A que horas você…? — Às 7:30. / E você?
chunks.tip: Hora: at + hora. 7:30 = seven thirty, 4:45 = four forty-five, 5:00 = five o'clock. Cuidado: 7:13 (thirteen) x 7:30 (thirty)! E How about you? devolve a pergunta.
examples: What time do you wake up?
OK, I'm gonna go jogging at 7:30. How about you?

practice.pt: A que horas você vai dormir?
practice.en: What time do you go to sleep?
What time do you go jogging?
I wake up at 6:30. How about you?
alt: I wake up at six thirty. How about you?

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
What time do you wake up?
grammar.tip: Com I, you, we e they o verbo fica igualzinho. Pra negar: don't. Pra perguntar: Do no começo. E hora sempre com at: at 7:30.

gossips.title: Max, the 4 AM Alarm

lines.text: This is Carlos, from apartment 6, and Max, his dog.
Every day, I wake up at 6:30. **Well**, not this week.
On Monday, I wake up at 4. Woof! Woof! It's Max!
Carlos, do you go jogging with Max?
No, I don't. I'm a mechanic. I'm tired!
**You know what?** My kids and I go jogging every day at 6 PM. Max is gonna go with us!
**So** now Max and I go jogging with Rosa. At 9 PM, we go to sleep. No more 4 AM!

gossips.title: Sam and the 2 AM Games

lines.text: Rosa is Sam's mom. Sam is 15.
Sam, it's 7:15! School is at 7:45!
Mom… I go to sleep at 2. I don't wake up at 7!
At 2?! What do you do at 2 AM?
I play video games with my friends.
OK. No video games on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday!
And on Friday?
On Friday, we play video games together. **To be honest**, I'm really good!
**So** now I go to sleep at 10. And on Friday? My mom is the champion!
